text: VR-based stress paradigms do not induce stress as a unitary construct but selectively engage distinct response systems depending on paradigm characteristics. Integrating early adversity may enhance the precision of VR-based stress research. This framework may support future investigations of stress-related behaviors, including eating behavior, in ecologically valid environments. It may also offer promising applications for personalized nutrition; however, these implications were not directly assessed in the included studies.
source_label: Virtual reality-based stress paradigms and early adversity: a scoping review of mechanisms and stress-response systems
